LanguageData.CC_Settings_ItemCardFirst_Tip: Opening the info for food, a drink, a drug, medicine, a material (metal, wood, stone blocks, cloth, leather, wool, chunks, components, chemfuel and the like) or a work of art, held or placed (the "i" button anywhere, a trade screen, a bill, a list, the inspect pane) opens Rimfolk's item card instead of the game's: what it is good for in this colony, its tags, how it keeps, who at home eats or takes it and why, what a material does to what is made of it and what waits on it, what a work of art does for its room, the colony's stock and where it comes from, and how traders value it. Its button "All the game's stats" opens the game's card, and the game's card keeps its button back. Links followed inside the game's card stay in it. Off, the game's card opens as before, with a button to Rimfolk's card at its foot. The rest (books, body parts, techprints and the like) comes later.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_ItemCardFirst: Food, drink, drugs, medicine, materials and art open as Rimfolk's item card; the game's card is one button away.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_NotCovered: Rimfolk's item card shows food, drink, drugs, medicine, materials and art for now; this opens in the game's own card.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_GameCard_Tip: Open the game's own info card for this, with every stat it lists. Its button "Rimfolk's item card" brings you back here.
LanguageData.CC_ItemCard_OpenCard_Tip: Open Rimfolk's card for this: what it is good for in this colony, its tags, the colony's stock and what waits on it, where it comes from, and how traders value it.
